description: Customizable in-game overlay for FPS, frame-time lows, CPU/GPU usage and temperatures, ping, and packet loss.
notes: Uses the official GameOverlay-folder.zip onedir build rather than the single-file self-extracting executable. The upstream build script creates this ZIP from the contents of dist/onedir/GameOverlay, so the manifest launches GameOverlay.exe from the extracted application root without an extract_dir wrapper.

The application requests administrator access at runtime for FPS capture, ping detection, and CPU sensor access. Scoop only extracts the ZIP; it does not run a vendor installer or install a driver or service.
Settings are saved outside Scoop at %APPDATA%\\GameOverlay\\config.json. Scoop uninstall therefore leaves the application's settings file in place.

The overlay cannot draw over exclusive-fullscreen games; use Borderless or Windowed Fullscreen mode. If CPU temperature is unavailable because Windows blocks the bundled sensor driver's access, the upstream-supported fallback is to run Core Temp. Do not disable the Windows vulnerable-driver blocklist as a workaround.
